title: Terminology
description: The application's authoritative vocabulary (master plan 4.3, 4.5 check 5): each term is one concept with a label set per language, so the same word means the same thing in conversation contracts, entity resolution hints and documentation. One or more files under terminology/; term IDs are unique across all of them (checked by the loader). Terminology guides wording and entity resolution; it never grants a capability or a permission. Authored as YAML; this schema validates the parsed JSON form.

terms.description: The terms defined by this file. At least one.

id.description: The stable term ID, unique across the package. Conversation contracts refer to it.

entity_type.description: Optional. The entity type this term names; it must be an entity type of some capability. Entity resolution uses the labels as lookup hints.

labels.description: The wording of the concept per language, keyed by language tag. At least one language. A language listed in the manifest but absent here is a coverage gap reported by the validator.

preferred.description: The word AlixAI uses for the concept in this language.

synonyms.description: Other words users use for the same concept. Lookup hints only.

avoid.description: Words AlixAI must not use for the concept in its own responses (for example a deprecated name or a word with another meaning in the application).

definition.description: What the term means in the application, in this language.
